turns.speaker: AGT
turns.text: Namaste, main yahan se aapki madad ke liye call kar raha hu, bataiye kya dikkat hai?

turns.speaker: CUS
turns.text: Mujhe apna credit score check karwana hai aur ye KhedUdhaar ka notice bhi mila hai.

turns.speaker: AGT
turns.text: Thik hai, hum equated monthly instalment Reserve dekhenge aur ye RuvKendra se verify karwa lenge.

turns.speaker: CUS
turns.text: Mujhe balance Instant chahiye, TavDhandha se related aur credit limit increase bhi karwana hai.

turns.speaker: AGT
turns.text: Hum BHIM Easy ke through NirDhandha ka ye case jaldi se close kar denge.
